zh-CN.title: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然
zh-CN.subtitle: 《道德经》第二十五章
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这句章句把人、地、天、道和自然排列为层层相应的秩序，需要结合传世文本语境理解。
curatorialDescription: ‘道法自然’常被单独引用为生活格言；在《道德经》第二十五章中，它位于关于道的命名与秩序关系的连续论述中。
zh-CN.researchNote: Alpha 条目暂以通行章次为定位，后续补充出土本、传世本和主要注本差异。

quote.original: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。

interpretation.zh-CN: 章句以层层相应的关系说明道的秩序，不等同于现代语境中的‘顺其自然’口号。
interpretation.en: The chapter describes a layered relation of correspondence; it should not be reduced to the modern slogan ‘go with the flow’.

en.title: Humans follow earth; earth follows heaven
en.subtitle: Daodejing, chapter 25
en.shortSummary: The line arranges humans, earth, heaven, the Dao and naturalness in a layered order that must be read in its received-text context.
curatorialDescription: ‘Dao follows naturalness’ is often detached as a lifestyle maxim. In chapter 25 of the Daodejing it belongs to a sustained discussion of naming and order.
en.researchNote: The Alpha entry uses the received chapter locator; excavated texts, received editions and major commentaries remain to be compared.
